description: Perform Bader charge analysis on a gas-phase H2O molecule.
user_prompt: Perform Bader charge analysis on a gas-phase H2O molecule in a vacuum box. Report the Bader net charge (in electrons) for O atom and H atoms.

references: Tang, Sanville & Henkelman, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 21, 084204 (2009)
method.modeling: Single H2O molecule centered in a >= 15 Angstrom cubic box; the two H are equivalent by C2v.
method.rationale: Values from the GPAW Bader tutorial reference H2O run: O Bader population 9.1505 e -> net -1.15 e, and 0.58 e transferred from each H -> H +0.58 e. The key_parameters are the recommended VASP protocol; the small functional/grid difference vs the GPAW reference stays within +/-0.10 e.
